implementation.authority_boundary: Primary Chat approval is sanitized input metadata only. Page Change packet + existing CURRENT/PIN/claim semantics remain execution authority.

behavior.approved: Explicit APPROVED envelope with approval_id, proposal_id, SHA-256 proposal_digest and approved_at enters the existing private Capture -> Page Change WORKER_POOL -> sanitized wake path.
behavior.rejected_or_ambiguous: submitApprovedPlan returns a boundary before transport; no Capture/Page Change/wake call occurs.
behavior.same_browser_replay: A successful approval stores only a sanitized local receipt index keyed by approval_id; exact replay returns QUEUED_REPLAY without a second transport. Reusing approval_id with a different digest fails closed.
behavior.stable_private_correlation: Approved requests use deterministic request_id approval-<approval_id>; the private capture metadata and Page Change semantic_anchor carry approval_id/proposal_id/proposal_digest without publishing raw text.
behavior.wake_privacy: Wake receives work_item_id/page_id/return_path plus sanitized approval identifiers/digest only; raw approved-plan text remains in the existing private owner.

covers: raw text absent from sanitized wake

known_residuals: The V11 UI does not yet call submitApprovedPlan from a proposal/Approve control; this source API is the materialization hook for that separate UI/planning lane.

Cross-device/server-side approval replay dedupe is not yet proven. Current protection is deterministic capture identity plus a browser-persistent sanitized receipt index; the existing Page Change backend does not yet query approval_id before creating a packet.
No served authenticated end-to-end approval canary was run in this worker. The private Page Change path remains externally degraded/unverified, so SOURCE_PASS must not be promoted to runtime PASS.
